title: How to Record Inpatient Vitals and Fluid Balance in HIS
content:
ARTICLE: How to Record Inpatient Vitals and Fluid Balance in HIS (KA-012)
SYSTEM: HIS Nursing
DEPARTMENT: Nursing Administration
VERSION: 1.9
OVERVIEW: This comprehensive operating guide details how hospital personnel should interact with the HIS Nursing module to execute how to record inpatient vitals and fluid balance in his safely and reliably.
STEPS:
Step 1: Open the HIS Nursing client terminal on any networked SMCH workstation and log in with role credentials.
Step 2: Enter the patient's unique UHID or Case Number to load active records.
Step 3: Access the designated submenu corresponding to How to Record Inpatient Vitals and Fluid Balance in HIS and verify current patient status.
Step 4: Input all required clinical or administrative parameters, ensuring mandatory fields are validated.
Step 5: Verify preview confirmation modal and click 'Submit' to persist changes to the database.
Step 6: Print barcode, acknowledgement chit, or receipt as required by hospital compliance.
- [ISSUE & FIX] Connection timeout: Verify LAN cable connection or contact IT Helpdesk.
- [ISSUE & FIX] Permission Denied: Ensure user account has the assigned role in staff master permissions.
Contact Nursing Administration coordinator or IT Operations Support at Extension 1033 (Email: it@smch.in).
